purpose: Exact validation-only ETTh2 H96 AutoCon lambda control for the frozen stride-24 MambaTSv3 candidate.
research_question: Holding the stride-24 MambaTSv3 architecture fixed and prediction fusion disabled, does AutoCon lambda=.001 improve ETTh2 H96 validation MSE relative to the exact lambda-zero control?
architecture: Both arms use one MambaTSv3 Mamba-1 patch scan, low-rank context, stride-24 patching, and the same train-time representation interface. Only the contrastive AutoCon weight changes from .001 to 0; prediction-connected fusion stays disabled in both arms.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exact paired mechanism matrix. All jobs skip the test loader and save no predictions, test metrics, or streaming artifacts.
claim_boundary: A favorable contrast supports only the named train-time AutoCon objective on ETTh2 H96. It does not establish held-out accuracy, universal AutoCon causality, or universal generalization.

required_before_launch: verify the ETTh2 fingerprint and exact six-job expansion
freeze architecture, split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, and seeds except AutoCon lambda
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Architecture, split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed. Only AutoCon lambda changes between phases; the test split cannot be used for selection.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share chronological split, features, input/output lengths, MambaTSv3 width, patching, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.active_difference: AutoCon lambda=.001 with train-time representation returned to the existing AutoCon trainer.
capacity_fairness_contract.null_difference: Only AutoCon lambda=0; AutoCon-capable MambaTSv3 graph and prediction path remain otherwise identical.

comparison_contract.local_gate: Mean active/control ratio < 1, at least 2/3 active wins, and no individual active degradation above 2%; failure is a negative result and does not license retuning.

stopping_rules: Do not tune lambda, architecture, width, patching, or epochs after observing this matrix.
Do not promote a causal AutoCon claim if the predeclared local gate fails.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh2 fingerprint and exact six-job expansion
